Month Picker

The Month Picker selects a month without showing individual days. A 3×4 grid of month cells sits under a year navigator.

Basic Month Picker

Click the field to open the grid. The current month is tinted with the primary color; your selection fills with a solid fill.

Pick a month.

HTML
<div class="zak-month-picker">
    <button type="button" class="zak-month-field">
        Select month
    </button>
    <div class="zak-month-popup">
        <div class="zak-calendar-header">
            <button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn">&lt;</button>
            <span class="zak-calendar-title">2026</span>
            <button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn">&gt;</button>
        </div>
        <div class="zak-month-grid"><!-- Jan..Dec cells --></div>
    </div>
</div>

Year Navigation

The chevrons move the year backwards and forwards; the grid always shows the twelve months of the displayed year.

HTML
<div class="zak-calendar-header">
    <button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn" id="prevYr">&lt;</button>
    <span class="zak-calendar-title" id="yearLabel">2026</span>
    <button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn" id="nextYr">&gt;</button>
</div>

<script>
    var year = 2026;
    prevYr.onclick = function () { year--; render(); };
    nextYr.onclick = function () { year++; render(); };
    function render() {
        yearLabel.textContent = year;
        // fill .zak-month-grid with 12 cells for `year`
    }
</script>

Disabled Months

Months in the past or outside a contract window can be disabled so users never pick an invalid period.

HTML
// Disable months before today during render:
MONTHS.forEach(function (month, i) {
    var cell = monthCell(month, i);
    if (year === today.getFullYear() && i < today.getMonth()) {
        cell.disabled = true;
    }
    return cell;
});

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-month-picker              /* Relative wrapper (field + popup) */
.zak-month-field               /* Readable trigger */
.zak-month-popup               /* Popup with grid (hidden until active) */
.zak-month-grid                /* 3-by-4 month grid */
.zak-month-cell                /* Single month button */
.zak-month-cell.zak-selected   /* Chosen month */
.zak-month-cell.zak-current    /* Current month (today's month) */
.zak-month-cell:disabled       /* Unselectable months */

// Reused:
.zak-calendar-header, .zak-calendar-title, .zak-calendar-nav-btn

// Toggle class:
.zak-month-popup-active        /* Shows the popup */

JavaScript

HTML
// No library module — a tiny render loop is enough:

var MONTHS = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun',
              'Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
var selected = null;   // { year, month }

function render() {
    yearLabel.textContent = year;
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    MONTHS.forEach(function (name, i) {
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'zak-month-cell';
        b.textContent = name;
        var now = new Date();
        if (year === now.getFullYear() && i === now.getMonth()) b.classList.add('zak-current');
        if (selected && selected.year === year && selected.month === i) b.classList.add('zak-selected');
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
            selected = { year: year, month: i };
            field.textContent = name + ' ' + year;
            render();
        });
        grid.appendChild(b);
    });
}

Accessibility

  • Each month is a native <button>, focusable and keyboard-usable; year chevrons follow the same pattern.
  • Update the trigger text on every pick — the year label and selection both announce a concrete value.
  • Disabled months must be disabled, not faded text, so they are skipped by assistive tech too.
  • Pair with a full Calendar when users also need day-level precision.
